info.name: Managed Database for PostgreSQL and MySQL Access Control List VPC Connectors API

params.name: region
params.description: The region you want to target

params.name: order_by
params.description: Sort order of the returned VPC connectors.

params.name: page
params.description: Page number to return, from the paginated results.

params.name: page_size
params.description: Maximum number of VPC connectors to return per page.

params.name: name
params.description: Name to filter for. Only connectors with names containing this string will be returned.

params.name: tags
params.description: Tags to filter for. Only connectors with one or more matching tags will be returned.

params.name: organization_id
params.description: Organization ID to filter for. Only connectors belonging to this Organization will be returned. (UUID format)

params.name: project_id
params.description: Project ID to filter for. Only connectors belonging to this Project will be returned. (UUID format)

params.name: vpc_id
params.description: VPC ID to filter for. Only connectors belonging to this VPC will be returned. (UUID format)

params.name: target_vpc_id
params.description: Target VPC ID to filter for. Only connectors belonging to this target VPC will be returned. (UUID format)

params.name: status
params.description: Status of the VPC connector.

items.docs: List existing VPC connectors in the specified region.
